cases.setup: mkdir -p proj/src proj/.git; : > proj/Makefile; : > proj/README; : > proj/.hidden

cases.name: with -a
cases.setup: mkdir -p proj/src proj/.git; : > proj/Makefile; : > proj/README; : > proj/.hidden

cases.name: capitals before lowercase, as in strcmp
cases.setup: mkdir d; : > d/b; : > d/B; : > d/a; : > d/A; mkdir d/_z

cases.name: many entries
cases.setup: mkdir many; for i in $(seq 1 500); do : > many/f$i; done

cases.name: a directory that does not exist
cases.stdout:
myls: nope: No such file or directory
rc=1

cases.name: a file is not a directory
cases.stdout:

rc=1
